title: Per-step model override in executor
problem: The executor uses a single model (from config) for all plan steps. Some steps require stronger reasoning (e.g. complex refactors) while others are simple (e.g. adding imports). There is no way to specify a different model for individual steps.
description: Add optional per-step model override to the executor: (1) executor.py reads an optional model field from each step in the plan JSON, (2) if present, that model is used for the claude -p call for that step instead of the config default, (3) if absent, falls back to executor.model from config.json as today, (4) validate_plan.py accepts the optional model field without erroring (must be a known alias: opus, sonnet, haiku).
scope: Modified: runner/executor.py (per-step model read and subprocess call). Modified: runner/validate_plan.py (accept optional model field, validate alias). No new files.
context: Plan JSON has a steps array where each step has fields like description, files, instructions. The new model field would sit alongside these. Config default is executor.model = sonnet. Known model aliases are opus, sonnet, haiku.
